about.title: About & disclaimer
about.d1: This is a clinical decision-support reference for qualified health professionals. It does not replace clinical judgment, local protocols or the product information.
about.d2: The project remains pending clinical validation for operational use. A technical check or a review of one component does not approve every function, population or care setting.
about.d3: Local or pharmacy standard concentrations override the example preparations. Always confirm ampoule strength (base vs salt), diluent, final volume and concentration before calculating.
about.d4: Worked examples (70 kg) are arithmetic references, not prescriptions. Do not extrapolate the adult infusion tool to children; pediatric tools have their own scope and safety requirements.
about.d5: Double-check every pump setting independently and use a smart pump with the local drug library.
about.provenanceBody: Clinical modules, procedures and pediatric catalogues derive from the canonical project sources. Adult infusion data retain their versioned reference baseline. Consult each component for source, date and evidence status; automated arithmetic checks do not establish clinical validation.
about.privacyBody: Preferences are stored on this device. Some functions, including clinical notes and pediatric calculations, require a configured service; offline availability varies by tool. Check the data-handling policy of the deployment and do not enter patient identifiers.
about.scopeBody: Emergency is designed as a shared, extensible foundation for emergency and acute-care support, education and research across countries and care settings. Each capability has its own supported scope and validation status.
about.scopeContext: Language does not determine the applicable country or clinical pathway. Product information, organizational resources and clinical requirements must match the intended setting; experience in one hospital does not establish approval elsewhere.
